fields.label: Dry run
fields.help: Log every detection but never kick or ban. Use it while tuning.

fields.label: Bypass ACE permissions
fields.help: Players with any of these ACEs are logged but never punished or countered. For a single detection add the code: e.g. add_ace group.police jcks_anticheat.bypass.WPN_GIVE_ALL allow.

fields.label: Max health
fields.help: Highest health a player may legitimately have.

fields.label: Expected weapon damage modifier
fields.help: Set if your server changes SetPlayerWeaponDamageModifier.

fields.label: Undo cheat effects (countermeasures)
fields.help: Even when a detection only logs or warns, its effect is reverted: spawned entities deleted/blocked, godmode/invisibility/noclip/spectate switched off, health/armour/vehicle repair/plate/handling restored, teleports put back, unauthorised revives killed, extra weapons removed, explosions/projectiles/fires/particles cancelled. Health, armour and revive reverts need the shield installed (it tells legitimate heals apart).

fields.label: Codes to leave alone
fields.help: Detections whose effect is not reverted (still detected and scored).

fields.label: Ban at score
fields.help: Bans always need server-side evidence; client flags alone stop at a kick.

fields.label: Severity overrides
fields.help: One per line as CODE=points, e.g. VEH_HANDLING=10. Overrides the default score a detection adds (see docs/THREAT_MATRIX.md for codes and defaults).

fields.label: Ignored codes
fields.help: Switched off entirely. The client stops reporting them.

fields.label: Log-only codes
fields.help: Recorded and shown, never punished.

fields.label: Disconnect-immediately codes
fields.help: Kick at once regardless of score (never a ban by themselves).

fields.label: Ban-immediately codes
fields.help: Ban on the first detection regardless of score, e.g. NET_HONEYPOT or WPN_EXPLOSION_BLAME. Use only for codes you trust on your server.

fields.label: Trusted resources
fields.help: One per line as resource=behaviour,behaviour. When that resource heals, teleports, etc. the player (seen by the shield), the matching detections are paused for a moment. Behaviours: heal, armor, godmode, teleport, invisible, noclip, spectate, vehicle, weapons, camera, ragdoll, vision, * (everything).

fields.label: Use built-in presets
fields.help: Rules for popular resources (txAdmin, vMenu, qb-*, esx_*, ox_inventory, appearance, garages, mechanics, phones...) from integrations.presets.json, applied to resources you run. Your own rules override them.

fields.label: Trust every resource file on the client
fields.help: When any resource's own script (not injected code) heals, revives, teleports, etc. the player, the matching client detections and countermeasures pause for 3 s. Prevents killing players revived by a custom death script you haven't listed. Server-side grace still requires Trusted resources. Code injected by executors is never trusted.

fields.label: Server trusts reported resource actions
fields.help: The server accepts heals/teleports/etc. that the shield saw a running resource perform (sent inside the encrypted heartbeat), pausing its own checks for 3 s. Turn off for strict mode: only Trusted resources get server-side grace.

fields.label: Learning mode
fields.help: Records what each resource does to players. 'jac integrations suggest' lists rules to add, 'jac integrations apply' saves them.

fields.label: Handshake timeout (s)
fields.help: Time in the world before a client must have handshaked.

fields.label: Honeypot event names
fields.help: Decoy events nothing legitimate triggers.

fields.label: Protected server events
fields.help: One per line as event=max per minute, e.g. esx_jobs:pay=10. Triggers over the limit are reported (NET_EVENT_SPAM) and cancelled.

fields.label: Max weapons held at once
fields.help: More than this looks like a 'give all weapons' option.

fields.label: Blacklisted weapons
fields.help: Weapon names, e.g. WEAPON_RPG.

fields.label: Allowed ped models
fields.help: Empty allows every model.

fields.label: Blacklisted explosion types
fields.help: eExplosionTag ids, e.g. 18 = explosive ammo.

fields.label: Projectile origin max distance (m)
fields.help: How far from the shooter a projectile may start (on foot).

fields.label: Blacklisted texture dictionaries
fields.help: Texture dictionaries only cheat menus stream in. Add names you've confirmed on your server; empty by default.

fields.label: Anti-dump
fields.help: Client scripts of protected resources are not downloaded into the game cache; the anticheat streams them after the handshake and the shield runs them. Protect a resource with 'jac antidump protect <resource>' in the server console (backs up the manifest; 'unprotect' restores it). Needs the shield.

fields.label: Protected resources
fields.help: resource=client/file.lua,client/other.lua. Filled by 'jac antidump protect'.

fields.label: Refuse names with HTML/script
fields.help: Blocks chat/scoreboard/NUI injection through player names.

fields.label: Blocked words in names
fields.help: Case-insensitive; players whose name contains one are refused at connect.

fields.label: Detect chat spoofing
fields.help: Reports and cancels chat messages sent under another player's name (cfx chat).

fields.label: API key environment variable
fields.help: The key itself is never stored in config.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: Scans every resource's .lua/.js/.cs files for backdoor patterns: remote code execution, shell commands, secret convars, ACE grants, manifest writes, encoded payloads, obfuscated JS.

fields.label: Scan on every server start
fields.help: Results are printed to the server console with an id per finding. Run 'jac scan' any time.

fields.label: Automatic action
fields.help: none = only report and wait for 'jac scan remove|quarantine <id>'. remove deletes the flagged line (backup kept as .jac-bak). quarantine moves the file into .jac-quarantine/.

fields.label: Ignored finding ids
fields.help: Reviewed false positives. 'jac scan ignore <id>' adds them here.

fields.label: Disabled rules
fields.help: LUA_REMOTE_LOAD, JS_REMOTE_EVAL, SHELL_EXEC, SECRET_CONVAR, ACE_GRANT, MANIFEST_WRITE, FS_WRITE_OTHER, ENCODED_PAYLOAD, LOAD_ENCODED, CFG_READ, JS_OBFUSCATED, HUGE_LINE

fields.label: Webhook URL environment variable
fields.help: Set this variable on the FiveM process to the webhook URL. The URL itself is never stored in config.

fields.label: Post detections from
fields.help: Bans and settings changes are always posted.
